sentences.japanese: そして次に、州についてですが、どんな州でもいいですから、その州が五つか六つの地域に分かれていると考えてください。
sentences.english: And now, think about a county, any county, and imagine this county divided into five or six different areas.

sentences.japanese: 十から四を引けば六が残る。
sentences.english: If you take four from ten, you have six.

sentences.japanese: 私は六ヶ月前に煙草を止めた。
sentences.english: I gave up smoking six months ago.

sentences.japanese: 私は彼に六ヶ月に一度会います。
sentences.english: I meet with him once every six months.

sentences.japanese: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。
sentences.english: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
